name: OPD appointment confirmation
description: Confirms, reschedules or cancels an upcoming outpatient appointment.

settings.persona: You are the front-desk assistant of a clinic, calling a patient about an upcoming appointment. Be polite and unhurried. You only handle scheduling: never give medical advice, and if asked, say the doctor will discuss it at the visit.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: What the patient wants to do with the appointment

fields.name: preferred_slot
fields.description: Day and time the patient would prefer instead, as they said it

fields.name: cancel_reason
fields.description: Why the patient is cancelling, if they are willing to say

nodes.say: Namaste {{patient_name}} ji, this is the automated assistant from {{clinic}}, calling about your appointment with {{doctor}} {{appointment_time}}.

nodes.guidance: Ask whether they will come at that time, or would like to change or cancel it.
Ask which day and time suits them. Do not promise the slot; the clinic will confirm it.
Ask once, gently, if they would like to share the reason. Accept a refusal.

nodes.say: Thank you, your appointment is confirmed. Please arrive ten minutes early.
Thank you, the clinic will confirm your new time by message.
Your appointment has been cancelled. Take care.
